content.text: [Slack #incident-20241103 kenji.nakamura Mon Nov 04 22:05 UTC 2024] AROS v4.2 manually halted. timezone_config.py line 42: UTC_OFFSET = -4 (should be -5 after Nov 3 DST switch). CME settlement triggered 1 hour early.
Confirmed root cause: UTC_OFFSET = -4 hardcoded, not updated after EDT→EST switch. CME daily settlement at 15:00 CT = 21:00 UTC in EST (not 20:00 UTC). T+1 cutoff also offset by 60 minutes.

[Slack #incident-20241103 sophie.devereux Tue Nov 04 09:15 UTC 2024] MiFIR Field 28 correction required. FCA Market Watch 59 is explicit: Field 28 must be UTC, not local time. DST errors are the most common failure. KCG reference: penalty $12M, rule Rule 15c3-5(b), loss $460M+ (not $440M).

Noted. Field 28 correction: affected period 2024-11-03T09:30:00Z to 22:00:00Z. All timestamps were offset by +1 hour (reported as UTC-4 local instead of UTC). KCG anchor: $460M+ loss (SEC 2013-222), $12M penalty, Rule 15c3-5(b).

[Slack #incident-20241103 marcus.chen Tue Nov 04 09:30 UTC 2024] The deprecated v3.1 router in code/legacy/ has UTC_OFFSET=-5 but that file is DEPRECATED 2023-06-01 and doesn't meet MiFIR UTC requirements. It cannot be used to fix the current incident.
Confirmed: aros_v3_1_router_DEPRECATED.py is deprecated 2023-06-01 and is not applicable to the current remediation. Fix must be in the current v4.2 codebase (code/aros/timezone_config.py).
